name: link-click
description: link-click — full-stack URL shortener with Chrome extension

scripts.dev: concurrently -n write,redirect,analytics -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @link-click/write-service" "npm run dev -w @link-click/redirect-service" "npm run dev -w @link-click/analytics-service"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n write,redirect,analytics,consumer -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @link-click/write-service" "npm run dev -w @link-click/redirect-service" "npm run dev -w @link-click/analytics-service" "npm run dev -w @link-click/kafka-consumer"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @link-click/types && npm run build -w @link-click/base62 && npm run build -w @link-click/validation && npm run build -w @link-click/write-service && npm run build -w @link-click/redirect-service && npm run build -w @link-click/analytics-service && npm run build -w @link-click/kafka-consumer
